title: Binormal Vector of a Space Curve
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Compute the binormal vector B(t) for the helix r(t) = <3 cos(t), 3 sin(t), 4t>.

steps.title: Take Cross Product B = T x N
steps.explanation: Evaluate the cross product of the unit tangent and normal vectors.

steps.title: Calculate Components of B
steps.mathExpression: \mathbf{B} = \mathbf{i}\left(0 - \left(-\frac{4}{5}\sin t\right)\right) - \mathbf{j}\left(0 - \left(-\frac{4}{5}\cos t\right)\right) + \mathbf{k}\left(\frac{3}{5}\sin^2 t + \frac{3}{5}\cos^2 t\right) = \left\langle \frac{4}{5}\sin t, -\frac{4}{5}\cos t, \frac{3}{5} \right\rangle
steps.explanation: Simplify the minors using sin^2(t) + cos^2(t) = 1.
